sloka: देवता मानुषा यक्षा ये चान्ये जगतीतले ।एवं त्वामभिधास्यन्ति रावणं लोकरावणम् ।। ७.१६.३९ ॥
transliteration: devatā mānuṣā yakṣā ye cānye jagatītale ।evaṁ tvāmabhidhāsyanti rāvaṇaṁ lokarāvaṇam ।। 7.16.39 ॥

translations.english: Gods, humans, yakshas, and all others on earth will thus call you Ravana, the one who makes the worlds cry.
